summary: End-to-end validation of iteration 7 (Motor de decisión editable — RAG + reglas + simulador). Backend: 20/20 pytest cases PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_motor.py after fixing a critical NameError bug in admin_router.py (has_perm→_has). KB stats returns {documents_total>=10, documents_published, documents_authoritative, chunks_indexed, by_goal:{}} from KNOWLEDGE_SEED, list endpoint paginates with {items, total, page, has_more} + full item schema (title, kind, goal_keys, chunks_count, status, is_authoritative), POST /admin/motor/kb/documents creates doc + auto-generates chunks (chunks_count>0), search finds newly-created 'diversificar ingresos' doc, PUT /authorize marks doc+chunks authoritative, DELETE soft-archives (status=archived, deleted_at set, chunks→is_published=false), GET /admin/motor/rules returns rules_by_goal with system:true fallback rules from taxonomy.py, POST /admin/motor/rules on a fresh goal migrates system rules→BD custom rows (verified: subsequent GET shows no system:true), PUT/DELETE rules work, /questions/financiamiento returns questions, /simulate run_llm=false returns rules_triggered (≥2 for financiamiento no-doc/no-hist scenario), priorities (deduped preserving order), rag_results (list), prompt_preview (string), llm_plan:null, run_llm=true returns llm_plan={situacion_actual, lectura_estrategica, recomendaciones[]} via gpt-5.2, real /diagnostic flow with RAG-integrated _build_plan completes and generates narrative, RBAC — newbie no-role user gets 403 on /admin/motor/kb/documents and /admin/motor/simulate; content_editor user can view+create+edit KB but gets 403 on POST /admin/motor/rules. Frontend Playwright: login as maria, sidebar shows 'Motor de decisión' entry with Brain icon, /admin/motor renders admin-motor-hub with 3 cards (Biblioteca, Reglas, Simulador), /admin/motor/biblioteca renders 4 metric cards + table + filters + admin-kb-new opens sheet with admin-kb-title, admin-kb-content, admin-kb-save (button works after saving via JS click), created doc appears in table with chunks_count>0, clicking row opens admin-kb-detail drawer with chunks section, /admin/motor/reglas renders tabs (admin-rules-tab-financiamiento) with 3 rule cards + admin-rule-new button, /admin/motor/simulador renders sim-goal selector + sim-answer-{qid} fields + sim-run button and after run shows triggered rules ('Formalizar figura jurídica...', 'Estudiar 3 postulaciones exitosas...'), priorities, RAG results section, and prompt debug (collapsible).

ui_bugs.issue: admin-kb-save button becomes non-clickable via normal Playwright click (Element outside viewport). Root cause: Sheet content area is height-limited (h-[calc(100vh-134px)]) and the sticky footer holding admin-kb-save sits below the scroll container. When Playwright tries to scroll to the save button, it scrolls the inner container but the button, being in a fixed footer, stays where it is and playwright reports 'outside viewport'. Works via JS .click(). At normal user scroll behaviour it is visible.

issues: When the diagnostic answers are very short (e.g. 'necesito 3000 usd / no tengo formalización / nunca postulé') combined with a goal_key filter, TF-IDF returns 0 matches even though several seeded financiamiento docs contain 'formalización'/'presupuesto'. The empty state 'Sin resultados relevantes en la biblioteca para este caso' shows correctly, but flag: RAG relevance for short queries + goal filter is fragile. Consider (a) OR-matching goal_keys against fallback (no filter) as a secondary pass, (b) query augmentation with the goal_title, or (c) lowering the score>0 threshold to score>=0.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Improve RAG recall for short-answer + goal_key filter combos in AdminMotorSimulador (see design_issues).
critical_code_review_comments: admin_router.py — CRITICAL BUG FIXED: lines 1141 and 1157 referenced `has_perm(user, ...)` but the module-level helper is `_has(user, perm)`. This caused `POST /admin/motor/kb/documents` and `PUT /admin/motor/kb/documents/{did}` to raise NameError → HTTP 500 for every request. Fixed to `_has(...)`. This bug would have broken the entire KB-create flow in production; strongly recommend adding a lint/import check.

admin_router._reindex_document: calls `kb_bump(db)` on every reindex which forces a full TF-IDF matrix rebuild on next search. Fine for small KB, but at O(1k docs) this becomes an N^2 problem. Consider incremental update or debounced version bump.
admin_router.simulate: `llm_error` path silently returns response with error string. Consider raising 502 or at least a warning header so frontend can display 'IA no disponible' clearly.

admin_router.simulate `run_llm=True` uses model default of LlmChat (no `.with_model(...)` call). If EMERGENT_LLM_KEY provider default drifts (e.g. from gpt-4o to something else), simulation quality changes silently. Recommend pinning model with `.with_model('openai','gpt-5.2')` for the simulator.

rag.py TfidfVectorizer stop_words warning at startup ('estais, estan, mas...' inconsistent with strip_accents='unicode'). Cosmetic — either preprocess the stop-word list with the same accent-stripping, or use TfidfVectorizer(stop_words=None) and rely on min_df/max_df.

rag.search filter `if score <= 0: continue` combined with goal_key filter can produce 0 results for short queries. Consider score > 0.02 threshold OR fallback to no-goal-filter when goal-filtered results are empty.

admin_router.kb_delete: soft-deletes with status='archived' but stats endpoint uses `{'deleted_at':{'$exists':False}}` while list uses same. Consistent. However, direct GET /kb/documents/{did} still returns archived docs — intentional but undocumented; consider a 410 Gone or a flag.
admin_router.rules_create migration path: iterates _DEFAULT_RULES synchronously with individual insert_one() calls. Use insert_many() for consistency and speed.

AdminMotorBiblioteca sheet: admin-kb-save button sits in a sticky footer relative to a scrollable inner container. Automated tools scrolling into view do not reach it. Consider moving to a normal-flow footer or using `scrollIntoViewIfNeeded` support.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Motor de decisión module fully validated after fix. Backend tests: `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> python -m pytest backend/tests/test_motor.py -v -o addopts=''`. rca of the issue: BUG FIXED — admin_router.py:1141,1157 called undefined function `has_perm(user, 'engine.kb.authorize')`. The module defines the helper as `_has(user, perm)` (line 49). This raised NameError at request time, returning HTTP 500 for POST /admin/motor/kb/documents (create) and PUT /admin/motor/kb/documents/{did} (edit) — completely blocking KB creation and edit from every user, superadmin included. Reproduction: `POST /api/admin/motor/kb/documents` with any valid payload as maria → 500 Internal Server Error + backend log `NameError: name 'has_perm' is not defined`. Mitigation: replaced both call sites with `_has(user, 'engine.kb.authorize')`. Verified by re-running the full backend suite (20/20 pass) and by creating a KB doc from the frontend (visible in table with chunks_count > 0). Recommendation: add a lint step / integration smoke test for admin/motor/kb/documents POST since this endpoint has no other functional coverage in the previous iteration tests.
